observations: Photo 0 and photo 2 show the same metal transmission/transfer case assembly lying on wet concrete ground, next to other engine/transmission parts.
Casing has visible wiring harnesses, a torque converter/flange with surface rust at one end, and chalk marks ('CA', a blue scribble, a green dot) that look like yard sorting marks, not part numbers.
No stamped VIN, part number, or ID tag is legible on the casing in any photo.
Photo 1 shows a wider yard scene with multiple stacked engines/transmissions and a person's leg, confirming this is a salvage/teardown yard, not a single verified unit.
A semi-transparent watermark reading 'GEARUP INC.' appears on all three photos; this is the seller's own branding, not proof of the part's origin.
No odometer, donor-vehicle photo, test bench, or video clip of the transmission shifting/turning is shown.

claims.evidence: No casing tag, part number, or VIN sticker is readable in photo 0, 1, or 2 to confirm make/model/engine fitment.
No odometer photo, import paperwork, or donor vehicle image is shown in any of the 3 photos.

risks.risk: Exact make/model/year fitment cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped ID tag or casing number on the transmission housing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unidentified used gearbox, not confirmed Jeep Wrangler fitment

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition and functionality unknown
risks.proof: Video clip of the unit being turned by hand or bench-tested showing gear engagement, free of grinding noise.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for-parts condition

risks.risk: Claimed low mileage cannot be verified
risks.proof: Photo of donor vehicle odometer or import/teardown documentation.

risks.risk: Visible surface rust on output flange/pipe may indicate water exposure or long outdoor storage affecting seals
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seals, flanges, and the pan for corrosion or pitting.

risks.risk: Unit may be missing components (torque converter, sensors, mounts) needed for installation
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photo set showing all mating surfaces and connector ends.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming missing ancillary parts, buyer to source separately

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the stamped ID/part number tag on the transmission casing.
Video of the transmission being manually rotated or bench-tested to show gear engagement.
Photo of the donor vehicle's VIN plate or odometer to support the Jeep Wrangler and low-mileage claims.
Photos of all connector ends, torque converter, and mounting points to confirm completeness.
response.reason: The item is identifiable only as a used gearbox/transmission assembly by type; no tag or number confirms the claimed Jeep Wrangler fitment, mileage, or working condition, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, untested used unit pending the listed proof.
